name: Ayaan
face: Heart-shaped face with a wide forehead, wide-set round eyes, a short upturned nose, full cheeks, and a wide open smile that shows even teeth without a gap.
clothing: Teal Somaliland dirac with gold leafy embroidery and a gold hem, a pale mint headscarf edged in gold worn loosely over one shoulder, a mustard-yellow sash, small gold stud earrings (not hoops), a short coral bead necklace, and brown sandals.
proportions: A real child of about eight, natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Dense black two-strand twists with a mustard ribbon on the right side only, a spray of freckles across the nose bridge, and a pale mint headscarf draped loosely — never a tall wrapped gele.
hair: two-strand twists with mustard ribbon on right
skinTone: medium warm brown with golden undertone
countryLook: Somaliland highland child — teal-and-gold dirac, mint scarf, freckles; visually distinct from coastal Somali indigo Hodan
